question: Could you help me find the sellers who excel in the following categories, considering only delivered orders: the seller with the highest number of distinct customer unique IDs, the seller with the highest profit (calculated as price minus freight value), the seller with the highest number of distinct orders, and the seller with the most 5-star ratings? For each category, please provide the seller ID and the corresponding value, labeling each row with a description of the achievement.
sql:
WITH delivered_items AS (
    SELECT
        oi.seller_id,
        oi.order_id,
        oi.price,
        oi.freight_value,
        c.customer_unique_id,
        r.review_score
    FROM olist_order_items oi
    JOIN olist_orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN olist_customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN olist_order_reviews r ON oi.order_id = r.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
seller_distinct_customers AS (
    SELECT
        seller_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS distinct_customers
    FROM delivered_items
    GROUP BY seller_id
),
seller_profit AS (
    SELECT
        seller_id,
        SUM(price - freight_value) AS total_profit
    FROM delivered_items
    GROUP BY seller_id
),
seller_distinct_orders AS (
    SELECT
        seller_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS distinct_orders
    FROM delivered_items
    GROUP BY seller_id
),
seller_five_star AS (
    SELECT
        seller_id,
        COUNT(*) AS five_star_count
    FROM delivered_items
    WHERE review_score = 5
    GROUP BY seller_id
)
SELECT 'Most distinct customers' AS achievement, seller_id, CAST(distinct_customers AS DOUBLE) AS value FROM (SELECT seller_id, distinct_customers FROM seller_distinct_customers ORDER BY distinct_customers DESC LIMIT 1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Highest profit' AS achievement, seller_id, ROUND(total_profit, 2) AS value FROM (SELECT seller_id, total_profit FROM seller_profit ORDER BY total_profit DESC LIMIT 1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Most distinct orders' AS achievement, seller_id, CAST(distinct_orders AS DOUBLE) AS value FROM (SELECT seller_id, distinct_orders FROM seller_distinct_orders ORDER BY distinct_orders DESC LIMIT 1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Most 5-star ratings' AS achievement, seller_id, CAST(five_star_count AS DOUBLE) AS value FROM (SELECT seller_id, five_star_count FROM seller_five_star ORDER BY five_star_count DESC LIMIT 1);
